meta.description: Your company's memory for marketing and sales. Write it down once; every campaign, post and sales brief is written from it.

common.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

setup.envBody: Add these keys to the project's environment variables (in Vercel: Settings → Environment Variables, then redeploy; locally: .env.local, then restart). The secret key is in Supabase under Project Settings → API Keys:
setup.databaseTitle: Almost ready: set up the database
setup.databaseBody: Your keys work, but the database tables aren't there yet. Run this in the project folder, then reload:

brand.createBody: A brand holds one Company Brain. You can add more later — for another business or a client.
brand.newBody: Each brand has its own Company Brain, library and drafts.
brand.languageHelp: The language the AI writes in by default. You can change it for any single set.

errors.name: Enter a name of up to 80 characters.
errors.failed: Couldn't create the brand. Please try again.

brain.title: Company Brain
brain.subtitle: Everything {name} writes comes from here. The more specific you are, the less generic the output.
brain.voiceHelp: How you sound. Applied to every piece, in every language.
brain.tipBody: Write the way you'd brief a new colleague. Real numbers and customer words beat adjectives.

company.label: What you do
company.help: What you sell and the result it gives, in one or two sentences.
company.placeholder: e.g. Booking software for independent yoga teachers: classes, payments and reminders in one app.

audience.label: Who it's for
audience.help: Who buys it: their role, company size or situation, and what they want.
audience.placeholder: e.g. Independent yoga teachers with 20–200 students who run their business from their phone.

problem.label: The problem you solve
problem.help: What goes wrong for them without you, and what it costs them.
problem.placeholder: e.g. They spend hours a week chasing payments and messages, and students drift away without reminders.

positioning.label: Why you, not the alternatives
positioning.help: What makes you different from competitors, or from doing it by hand.
positioning.placeholder: e.g. Built only for solo teachers — no studio features to pay for, set up in 10 minutes.

offer.label: Your offer
offer.help: Plans, prices, trial, guarantee — whatever someone needs to decide.
offer.placeholder: e.g. Free for up to 20 students. Pro is $19/month. 30-day money-back guarantee.

proof.label: Proof
proof.help: Real results, numbers or customer words you're happy to quote. Leave it empty rather than guess.
proof.placeholder: e.g. “I got my Sundays back.” — Maria, yoga teacher in Lisbon

voice_tone.label: Tone
voice_tone.help: Three to five words, plus anything you always do.
voice_tone.placeholder: e.g. Clear, warm, practical. Short sentences. Lead with the outcome.

voice_use.label: Words and phrases you use
voice_use.help: Your vocabulary: product terms, phrases customers recognize.
voice_use.placeholder: e.g. students, your practice, book a class, show up

voice_avoid.label: Words you never use
voice_avoid.help: The AI will never use these.

voice_example.label: A sentence that sounds like you
voice_example.help: One line from your site or a post you love.
voice_example.placeholder: e.g. Teach the class. We'll handle the rest.

errors.invalid: Check the fields: each can be up to 4,000 characters.

visual.title: Visual style
visual.help: How generated images look (Reel covers and scenes). Leave empty to let the AI choose.

colors.label: Brand colors
colors.placeholder: e.g. Deep navy #1B2A4A, warm orange #F28C28, off-white

look.label: Look and feel
look.placeholder: e.g. Real job sites and contractors at work, natural light, documentary photo style

avoid.label: Avoid
avoid.placeholder: e.g. Stock-photo handshakes, cartoon characters, neon colors

visual.needsUpdateBody: Run supabase/migrations/0003_visual_style.sql in Supabase → SQL Editor, then reload this page.

documents.title: Notes & documents
documents.help: Paste notes or upload files — sales decks, call notes, FAQs, past posts. PDF, Word, TXT or Markdown, up to 4 MB.
documents.empty: Nothing here yet. Notes and documents make the output far more specific.
documents.noteTitlePlaceholder: e.g. What customers say on calls
documents.noteContentPlaceholder: Paste anything useful about the business…
documents.truncated: Only the first 100,000 characters were kept.

errors.too_large: Files can be up to 4 MB.
errors.unsupported: Use a PDF, Word (.docx), TXT or Markdown file.
errors.no_text: We couldn't find text in that file. If it's a scanned PDF, paste the text as a note instead.
errors.failed: Couldn't read that file. Please try again.
errors.note_invalid: Add a title and some text.

studio.title: Content Studio
studio.subtitle: One idea in, a finished set out — written from your Company Brain.
studio.ideaPlaceholder: An angle, a customer question, a launch, a pasted note… e.g. Most teachers lose students because nobody reminds them to come back.
studio.sourceHelp: Optional: build the set from one of your notes or documents.
studio.customTonePlaceholder: Optional — e.g. for a Black Friday campaign
studio.generatingHint: Writing {count, plural, one {# piece} other {# pieces}} from your Company Brain. This usually takes 20–60 seconds.
studio.missingTitle: Your Company Brain needs a few facts first
studio.aiMissingBody: Add OPENAI_API_KEY to .env.local and restart the app.
studio.emptyBody: Pick what to write, add an idea and press “Write the set”. Every set is saved to your Library.
studio.pickOne: Pick at least one thing to write.
studio.needIdea: Add an idea or choose a source document.
studio.notSaved: The set was written but couldn't be saved to your Library. Copy anything you need.

leads.title: Find leads
leads.subtitle: Search professional profiles by role, industry, company size and country, then add the people you want as opportunities.
leads.notConfiguredBody: Add EXPLORIUM_API_KEY to .env.local (and to Vercel), then restart the app. Get the key from the Free API Key button on explorium.ai.
leads.aiPlaceholder: e.g. Owners of roofing and HVAC companies in the US with fewer than 50 employees
leads.aiHelp: The AI fills in the filters below and runs the search. You can adjust them and search again.
leads.aiNoFilters: The AI couldn't turn that into filters. Add who they are (role, industry, size or country).
leads.jobTitlesPlaceholder: e.g. Marketing manager, Head of growth
leads.industryHelp: Separate several with commas. Each is matched to standard industry names, e.g. “contractors” → General contractor.
leads.countHelp: Each person found costs about one credit.

campaigns.title: Campaign Studio
campaigns.subtitle: Pick a goal. Get a full marketing plan written from your Company Brain: strategy, a playbook per channel, email marketing, an A/B test, a launch plan and ready-to-post copy.
campaigns.empty: No campaigns yet. Plan your first one — it takes about a minute.
campaigns.planSubtitle: Tell the studio what you want to achieve. It writes the whole marketing plan from your Company Brain.
campaigns.offerPlaceholder: e.g. The new Pro plan, launching October 1
campaigns.audiencePlaceholder: Leave empty to use the audience from your Company Brain
campaigns.generatingHint: Writing the strategy, a playbook per channel, the email sequence, the A/B test and ready-to-post copy. This usually takes 1 to 3 minutes.
campaigns.describeGoal: Describe the goal in a few words.

results.subtitle: Log what each variant did. The read-out names the winner and the next test.
results.empty: No campaigns yet. Plan one in the Campaign Studio, or log one you ran elsewhere.
results.logOtherBody: For a test you ran outside Unison. Describe the two versions you compared.

results.analyzeHint: Reading the numbers against your Company Brain…

sales.subtitle: Find prospects, add the ones you want, and write one email campaign for all of them from your Company Brain.
sales.empty: No prospects yet. Find some above, or add one by hand.

hostinger.intro: Import the contacts, paste the 3 emails into a Reach campaign or automation, and send.

hostinger.tagsHelp: Written for Reach: the first name uses Reach's '{{name}}' tag, and the company becomes "your company" because Reach has no company field. Paste each subject and body into the Reach editor.
hostinger.subject: Subject
hostinger.step3: In Reach: Contacts → Import → upload the CSV (email, name and surname map automatically). Then create a campaign or automation with the 3 emails on the days shown.
